# Attio

Attio is a fully customizable workspace for your team's relationships and workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/attio/.

## Actions

- **Create Note**: This tool creates a new note on a given record in attio.
- **Create Record**: This tool creates a new record in attio for a specified object type (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces, etc.).
- **Delete Note**: This tool allows users to delete a specific note in attio by its id.
- **Delete Record**: This tool allows you to delete a record from attio permanently.
- **Find Record** (read-only): This tool allows users to find a record in attio by either its unique id or by searching using unique attributes.
- **Get Object Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific object type in attio, including all its attributes and their properties.
- **List Lists** (read-only): This tool retrieves all lists available in the attio workspace.
- **List Notes** (read-only): This tool lists all notes associated with a specific record in attio.
- **List Objects** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available objects (both system-defined and user-defined) in the attio workspace.
- **List Records** (read-only): This tool lists records from a specific object type in attio.
- **Update Record**: This tool updates an existing record in attio for a specified object type (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces, etc.).
